material.acceptance_criteria: A push to main starts no tests run: after the next push, gh api runs?head_sha=<sha> lists no tests run with event workflow_dispatch unless an operator dispatched it; the caller is named in the row notes.
material.description: After the closing push 53eecaea (10:48:56Z), two tests runs (40186321689 at 10:49:05Z and 40186341621 at 10:49:23Z, both event workflow_dispatch) ran on that sha, 5 jobs each. drain-ci-policy-12 did not dispatch them; the source is not identified. A tests run after every push defeats the CI-speed decision (ci-tests-on-demand-speed-decision): push runs would carry the test cost again. Find the caller (a gm-mcp push hook, a sibling lane, or a scheduled dispatch) and stop it; tests run only when an operator dispatches them.

material.resolution: Refuted: tests.yml has no push trigger; runs come from gm's external 'gh workflow run' post-publish call.
material.subject: tests.yml runs start as workflow_dispatch seconds after a push, which the on-demand move was meant to stop
material.witness_plan: gh api actions/runs?head_sha=<next push sha> per_page 20, event column, read by a verify-ci-tests-dispatched-after-push session.
